entries.snippet: A German-Rwandan national has been arrested on suspicion of complicity in murders during Rwanda's 1994 genocide. He is thought to have been personally involved in the killing of one victim.

entries.snippet: Protesters are clearly unwelcome ahead of the upcoming NATO summit in Ankara. Amid a strict public gatherings ban, 225 human rights and environmental activists as well as journalists have already been arrested.

entries.title: Spain heat wave kills over 1,000 in second-hottest June ever
entries.snippet: At least 1,028 people died during Spain's recent heat wave as the country endured its hottest January-to-June period on record. Scientists said the extreme heat across Europe was driven by climate change.

entries.title: Rebel Catholic group SSPX defies pope, consecrates bishops
entries.snippet: An ultra-traditionalist Catholic group has consecrated bishops without papal consent, risking a schism with the church in Rome. Pope Leo had begged the breakaway Society of Saint Pius X to reconsider its plan.

entries.snippet: Police have raided DFB offices and city halls in a probe into the alleged misappropriation of Euro 2024 tickets. Meanwhile, Germany’s coalition leaders are meeting to hammer out a reform package. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Middle East updates: Iran, US to attend talks in Qatar

entries.title: How the US shaped the world: 250 years of power and policies

entries.title: Germany saves forest from mining, US opens land to drilling

entries.title: EU slaps €3 duty on low-value imported packages

entries.title: Nationality dispute: What does an Indian passport prove?
